summary: Minerals Technologies Inc. (MTI) filed a Plan of Reorganization in Chapter 11 cases of its subsidiaries BMI OldCo Inc. and affiliated debtors, as announced via press release on June 29, 2026. The filing complies with a court deadline. No specific financial terms (stake, price, premium) are disclosed. The board is not explicitly recommending, and no advisors are named. Mechanically, the plan involves non-debtor affiliates; the bankruptcy proceedings are in the Southern District of Texas. Watch for court approval and potential creditor negotiations; risk-arb centers on plan confirmation and exit financing terms.
